name: El Imposible National Park
story: El Imposible National Park is a tropical forest and protected area in western El Salvador. Established on January 1, 1989, it covers 38.20 km² within the Apaneca llamatepec mountain range, and supports wildlife including pumas, oncillas, wild boars, king hawks and black-crested eagles.
matters: The park encompasses eight rivers that contribute to the watershed of Barra de Santiago and the coastal mangrove forests. In 1992, it was included on UNESCO's World Heritage Tentative List.
